newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound down due to dlr shortage.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound down due to dlr shortage.

text.p: The Egyptian pound fell slightly against the dollar in the private-sector market on Sunday due to a shortage of the U.S. currency in the market, bankers said.
"There aren't that many dollars in the market, there's strong demand, which is why the interbank market jumped up, but the supply is not there," said one banker.
Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3940 to 3.3955 pounds bid and 3.3950 to 3.3980 offered in the interbank market.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3945 pounds bid and 3.396875 offered. The averages compared with 3.3943 pounds bid and 3.3973 offered on Thursday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at opening as 3.391474 buy and 3.398065 sell.
